explanation: Allocate a circular array with at least one slot, even when the requested initial capacity is zero. Track the logical head and live count; the tail is the head plus the count modulo capacity. When full, copy live values in FIFO order into a doubled array and reset the head to zero. Constructor commands replace the queue and capacity. The complete operation adapter validates dequeue and size results and rejects unknown commands.
timeComplexity: Enqueue: O(1) amortized, O(q) for a growth copying q live values. Dequeue/Size: O(1). Construction allocates O(c) initialized slots for clamped capacity c >= 1.
spaceComplexity: O(max(c, q)) retained circular-buffer space for initial clamped capacity c and peak occupancy q since the last reset; growth temporarily uses O(q) additional slots.
attribution: Original Java circular-buffer implementation and complete reset-aware operation adapter independently authored for EPI Practice from its displayed queue contract. No upstream reference implementation adapted. Public EPIJudge interface and test framework retained under the repository LICENSE.
